purpose: Response-blind interface and schema qualification for a multi-site SeagrassNet Zostera external validation.
scientific_hypothesis: Among annual transect-years with recorded Zostera marina presence, lower source-year quantitative percent cover adds out-of-time information about next-year recorded loss beyond site/time/effort.

candidate_universe.site_selection: all SeagrassNet sites listed under United States of America or Canada on the public site/download directory; no selection by observed cover trajectory
candidate_universe.late_or_sparse_sites: retained through data parse and removed only by the frozen estimability rules, never by observed predictive sign

allowed_preflight_access.site_page_gets: only pages belonging to the frozen USA+Canada candidate universe

requirements.zero_and_missing_semantics: must be frozen before any biological download; if template alone is insufficient, public protocol documentation may be used but biological values may not

no_rescue: Do not open downloaded biological site data during preflight.
Do not select sites because they show decline, loss, recovery, or favorable model performance.
Do not treat missing cover as zero.
Do not weaken estimability floors after data access.
